metadata.name: deadroll_character
metadata.description: Deadroll character: player profiles, characters, gear, skills, bag.

instructions.name: create_character
docs: Race, class, predisposition, stats, appearance, up to 6 starting skills and the class
starter items (worn), plus the Core NFT (feature `nft`). Creates `Character`, `SkillSet`
and `Bag`.

accounts.name: owner
docs: The player: pays rent and owns the character and its NFT.

accounts.name: asset
docs: New keypair for the Core asset. Required with the `nft` feature.

accounts.name: skill_extras
docs: Patch 5: range, timing, HP threshold, AP cost and description of every skill.

instructions.name: create_profile
docs: One profile per wallet; it hands out character indexes.

instructions.name: equip
docs: Owner or their session key: wears soulbound item `item_index` in `slot`. Not while the
character is in a session.

accounts.name: signer
docs: The owner, or their session key with `session_token`.

instructions.name: freeze_tombstone
docs: Permissionless: freezes the Core NFT of a dead character.

accounts.name: asset
docs: deserialized (mpl-core's deserializers overflow the stack frame).

instructions.name: grant_rewards
docs: Session only: adds XP (level-ups) and resources to a locked, living character.

accounts.name: session_authority
docs: The session program's `["authority"]` PDA, checked against `GameConfig`.

instructions.name: lock_for_session
docs: Session only (CPI at `set_ready(true)`): checks the skills taken onto the map and locks
a living character into `session`, which freezes its bag and gear.

accounts.name: session_authority
docs: The session program's `["authority"]` PDA, checked against `GameConfig`.

accounts.name: owner
docs: The player, signer of `set_ready`: a session cannot lock someone else's character.

instructions.name: mark_dead
docs: Session only: the character dies and becomes a tombstone; its skills, bag and soulbound
items burn. No outgoing CPI.

accounts.name: session_authority
docs: The session program's `["authority"]` PDA, checked against `GameConfig`.

instructions.name: set_skill_description
docs: Owner's main wallet only: writes the description of skill `skill_index` (printable
ASCII, zero-padded), once. Not while the character is in a session.

instructions.name: spend_stat_points
docs: Owner's main wallet only: spends level-up stat points, `points` per `Stat`, all at once.
Not while the character is in a session.

instructions.name: unequip
docs: Owner or their session key: empties `slot`. Not while the character is in a session.

accounts.name: signer
docs: The owner, or their session key with `session_token`.

instructions.name: unlock
docs: Session only: releases the character from its session (`set_ready(false)`, or the end of
the party).

accounts.name: session_authority
docs: The session program's `["authority"]` PDA, checked against `GameConfig`.

types.name: Aspect
docs: Damage aspect (docs/DAMAGE_TYPES_AND_MIXES.md).

types.name: Bag
docs: `["bag", character]`: created with the character, because game moves never create accounts.

fields.name: resources
docs: Amount per resource kind.

fields.name: items
docs: Item assets (lane items, P1). Slot `i < item_count` is used.

types.name: Category
docs: Section 3: active (4 slots), reactive (1), passive (1).

types.name: Character
docs: `["character", owner, index]`. The frozen core comes first (CONTRACTS.md, section 4.1), so
other programs read it as `CharacterData` right after the discriminator.

fields.name: unspent_points
docs: Stat points from level-ups, not spent yet.

fields.name: nft_frozen
docs: The Core NFT got its permanent freeze after death (`freeze_tombstone`).

fields.name: gear
docs: Soulbound starter items and what is worn, by slot (docs/CHARACTER.md, section 10).
Changed only outside a session (`equip`, `unequip`); burned at death.

fields.name: class_tier
docs: Class trait tier, `1..=14` (1 best), next to the race trait tier `core.predisposition_tier`
(docs/CHARACTER.md, sections 6.3 and 10). Starts low, grows only deterministically.

fields.name: item_count
docs: Soulbound starter items given with the character.

types.name: CharacterData
docs: character `["character", owner, index]`.

fields.name: nft
docs: Core NFT asset; `None` under the `nft` fallback.

fields.name: stats
docs: Indexed by `Stat`.

fields.name: in_session
docs: The session that locked this character.

fields.name: state_version
docs: Bumped on every visible change (NFT uri cache key).

fields.name: predisposition
docs: Human: Piercing, Blunt or Blood. Forest elf: Fire, Cold or Lightning.

fields.name: stats
docs: Indexed by `Stat`: `STAT_BASE` each plus exactly `STAT_POINTS_START` spent.

fields.name: skills
docs: Up to 6: at most 4 active, 1 reactive, 1 passive, limited by class.

types.name: Effect
docs: Section 6. `None` only for pure damage. Debuffs and hard control first, then buffs;
`Heal` was appended later (a buff kind: restores HP up to the maximum).

types.name: EquipRef
docs: What one equipment slot holds. `index` is the soulbound record for `Soulbound`; `asset`
is the item NFT for `Asset` (crafting, later), default otherwise. In `deadroll_character`
`Gear`.

types.name: EquipSlot
docs: Equipment slot (docs/ART_DESCRIPTION.md, section 6.3); rings take two slots.

types.name: EquipSource
docs: What an equipment slot holds: nothing, a soulbound record of the character, or an item NFT
(crafting, later).

types.name: Gear
docs: What a character carries and wears (docs/CHARACTER.md, section 10; ITEMS_AND_CRAFT.md,
sections 2 and 10): the class starter items as soulbound records, which never leave the
character and take no bag slot, and the equipment by `EquipSlot`. `EquipSource::Asset` is
kept for item NFTs, so the layout does not change when they arrive.
Pure account logic: `crates/sim/tests/parity.rs` runs it against the simulator.

fields.name: items
docs: Records `0..item_count` are used.

fields.name: equipped
docs: Indexed by `EquipSlot`.

types.name: ItemBase
docs: Item base: the type of an item, its slot and base numbers (`deadroll_rules::ItemTuning`).
P0 has the class starter bases (docs/ITEMS_AND_CRAFT.md, section 10); recipes append more.

fields.name: item_index
docs: The soulbound record worn.

fields.name: replaced
docs: What the slot held before, if anything.

types.name: ItemRecord
docs: A soulbound item record (a class starter item), in `deadroll_character` `Gear`.

fields.name: level
docs: Item level (docs/ITEMS_AND_CRAFT.md, section 4).

types.name: LayerRef
docs: One sprite layer. `sprite_id == 0` means an empty layer.

types.name: NewSkill
docs: A starting skill: the blocks (usually a preset from `deadroll_skillcheck::presets`), the
player's name for it and the patch 5 blocks. The description comes with
`set_skill_description` (six of them do not fit one transaction with the rest).

types.name: PlayerProfile
docs: `["profile", owner]`: one per wallet, hands out character indexes.

fields.name: character_count
docs: Characters created so far; the next character gets this index.

types.name: Purpose
docs: Buff targets self or an ally, debuff targets an enemy.

types.name: RangeTag
docs: Range axis of a skill or a basic attack (docs/DAMAGE_TYPES_AND_MIXES.md, section 2).
Added in patch 5.

types.name: SkillBlocks
docs: Everything that gives a skill its mechanics. Text (name, description) is not here.

fields.name: source
docs: Power source tag. One value, so magical and martial never mix.

fields.name: form
docs: Form tag. One value, so strike and projectile never mix.

fields.name: aspects
docs: In order: the first is the main one (largest share). Only `aspect_count` are used;
unused slots must stay at the default value.

fields.name: aura_radius
docs: Aura radius in cells, `0` = not an aura (section 3.5).

fields.name: skill_index
docs: `SkillSet` index whose description was written (`SkillExtras.extras[skill_index]`).

types.name: SkillExt
docs: Blocks added in patch 5, stored next to [`SkillBlocks`] (a `SkillSet` record cannot grow
in place): the range and timing tags (docs/DAMAGE_TYPES_AND_MIXES.md, section 2) and the
HP threshold of a reactive trigger (docs/SKILL_BUILDER.md, section 3.2).

fields.name: range
docs: Melee or ranged: how far the skill reaches.

fields.name: timing
docs: Instant or over time. Only a tag for now (rules by tag come later).

fields.name: hp_below_pct
docs: `HpBelow` / `AllyHpBelow`: the trigger fires when HP drops below this percent of the
maximum. `0` for every other skill.

types.name: SkillExtra
docs: The patch 5 part of the skill at the same `SkillSet` index. Raw bytes (zero-copy): `range`
is a `RangeTag`, `timing` a `TimeTag`.

fields.name: hp_below_pct
docs: HP threshold of `HpBelow` / `AllyHpBelow`, percent; 0 for other skills.

fields.name: ap_cost
docs: `deadroll_skillcheck::Derived::ap_cost`: action points to use it, 0 for reactive and
passive skills.

fields.name: description
docs: Written once by `set_skill_description`; all zero until then.

types.name: SkillExtras
docs: `["skill_extras", character]`: what patch 5 adds to every skill of a character, by `SkillSet`
index (a `SkillSet` record cannot grow in place). Zero-copy: over 3 KB.

types.name: SkillRecord
docs: One skill: blocks plus values computed once at creation (`deadroll_skillcheck::derive`).

fields.name: shares_bp
docs: Share of the converted weapon base per aspect, bp; sums to `BP`.

fields.name: fusion
docs: `deadroll_skillcheck::fusion_id` of the first two aspects, `0` = none.

fields.name: cooldown
docs: In the character's turns, `0` = none.

types.name: SkillSet
docs: `["skills", character]`: every skill of a character; slot `i < count` is used.

fields.name: selection
docs: `SkillSet` indexes: 4 active, 1 reactive, 1 passive (`deadroll_skillcheck::NO_SKILL` = empty).

fields.name: points
docs: Points added, by `Stat`.

fields.name: stats
docs: The core stats after spending, by `Stat`.

fields.name: hp_max
docs: The stored maximum HP after spending (Endurance raises it).

types.name: Target
docs: Area comes later (append).

types.name: Trigger
docs: Section 3.2, reactive skills only.
